metadata: document_id, source, page, char_start, char_end, title, year, audience, document_type, language
vectorizer: OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536 dims), pgvector 0.8.7 cosine exact search
hypothesis: Baseline: small windows with overlap keep short evidence quotes inside one chunk more often than longer chunks

chunking: by_paragraph (blank-line paragraphs packed per page; oversized paragraphs hard-split)
hypothesis: Paragraph-aligned chunks should be more coherent and keep whole ideas, improving Hit@1 over A
notes: 554 chunks; 73485 doc tokens; only 17/110 pages have blank-line paragraph breaks after pypdf extraction, so 540/554 chunks are hard cuts of paragraphs longer than 700 chars (424 of them exactly 700 chars); only 14 chunks are packed real paragraphs

chunking: same chunks and vectors as B
filter: metadata @> question.filter (audience) when the question has a filter; otherwise no filter
hypothesis: Restricting to the audience given in the question removes cross-document distractors; only change vs B is the filter
notes: 8/17 dev and 2/5 test questions carry a filter; the others run unfiltered (identical to B)
